text: この　あたりは　たてものが　すくねえ　から　よく　はしってるぜ！

structure.jp: たてものが　すくねえ　から
よく　はしってるぜ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows something done regularly. てる is the casual shortened form. よく　はしってる = 'I'm often out riding'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives the reason for what follows. すくねえ is a rough way to say すくない. すくねえ　から = 'because there are few'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes your statement at the listener. はしってるぜ = 'I'm out riding, man!'.
